name: groundhog
description: Web search, read and research through a real stealth-patched Chrome. Text hidden from human readers is stripped before the model reads it and reported, every source carries a SHA-256 provenance receipt, and the SSRF guard is re-checked after redirects.

settings.name: CDP URL
settings.description: CDP endpoint of a stealth browser you already run, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9222. Leave unset and Groundhog pulls and starts the container itself (needs Docker or Podman).

settings.name: Auto-start the browser
settings.description: Set to false to manage the stealth Chrome container yourself. Defaults to true.

settings.name: SearXNG URL
settings.description: Your SearXNG instance for search, e.g. http://searxng:8080. Unset falls back to rendering a search page through the stealth browser.

settings.name: Token budget
settings.description: Tokens of content returned before truncation. Defaults to 20000.
